COMPUTER VISION

“did you get
the number plate?”

A camera, some OCR, and one less manual log.

License-plate recognition +

A YOLOv8 and OCR pipeline to read vehicle plates and log entry/exit records for premises access control. The next direction: stronger OCR, clearer evaluation metrics, and an ONNX/TensorRT deployment path.

EARLY ML EXPERIMENT

a personality test.
minus 50 questions.

A few words in. An MBTI guess out.

MBTI guesser +

An early text-classification experiment using Python, Pandas, scikit-learn, and a Kaggle dataset to guess an MBTI type from a short description. A learning project, rather than a validated personality assessment.

THE C++ DAYS

that assignment
looks familiar.

A small program for comparing submitted files.

Text similarity checker +

A C++ project that compares files and reports a percentage of shared content, built to help examine similarities between student assignments. Similarity is a clue for review, not proof of plagiarism.
